mapper.select: SELECT id FROM reservation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND (state='HELD_UNKNOWN' OR usage_quality='UNKNOWN' OR (state='RESERVED' AND category<>'DIRECTORY_STORAGE')) LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM invocation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND state IN ('RUNNING','OUTCOME_UNKNOWN') LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM model_dispatch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND state='DISPATCHED' LIMIT 1

SELECT p.tenant_id,p.task_id FROM task_directory p JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND t.id=p.task_id WHERE p.content_state<>'PURGED' AND p.retain_until<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND t.state IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM native_search_run n WHERE n.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND n.task_id=p.task_id AND n.phase<>'STOPPED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM task_attempt a LEFT JOIN worker_process w ON w.id=a.worker_id WHERE a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND a.task_id=p.task_id AND a.quiescent=FALSE AND (w.id IS NULL OR w.stopped=FALSE)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reservation r WHERE r.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND r.task_id=p.task_id AND (r.state='HELD_UNKNOWN' OR r.usage_quality='UNKNOWN' OR (r.state='RESERVED' AND r.category<>'DIRECTORY_STORAGE'))) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invocation i WHERE i.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND i.task_id=p.task_id AND i.state IN ('RUNNING','OUTCOME_UNKNOWN')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_dispatch d WHERE d.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND d.task_id=p.task_id AND d.state='DISPATCHED') ORDER BY p.retain_until,p.tenant_id,p.task_id LIMIT 32
mapper.update: UPDATE step SET request_snapshot=#{tombstone},response_snapshot=IF(response_snapshot IS NULL,NULL,#{tombstone}),request_cleanup_state='DIRECTORY_PURGED',retained_request_digest=request_digest,directory_cwd=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE invocation SET input_snapshot=#{tombstone},output_snapshot=IF(output_snapshot IS NULL,NULL,#{tombstone}) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}

UPDATE invocation_path_binding SET base_cwd=NULL,target_cwd=NULL,canonical_paths_snapshot=NULL,directory_evidence_snapshot=NULL,content_state='PURGED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND invocation_id=#{id}
UPDATE model_dispatch SET usage_snapshot=IF(usage_snapshot IS NULL,NULL,#{tombstone}) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE task SET request_snapshot=#{tombstone},goal=#{tombstone},summary=IF(summary IS NULL,NULL,#{tombstone}) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{taskId}
UPDATE task_directory SET content_state='PURGING',cwd=NULL,retained_digests=#{retained},cleanup_generation=#{generation} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND content_state='PRESENT'
UPDATE task_directory SET filesystem_receipt=#{receipt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND filesystem_receipt IS NULL
UPDATE task_directory SET content_state='PURGED',workspace_state='PURGED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId}
UPDATE reservation SET state='RELEASED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{holdId} AND category='DIRECTORY_STORAGE' AND state='RESERVED'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(t.request_snapshot),0)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(t.goal),0)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(t.summary),0) +COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(t.model_snapshot),0)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(t.tools_snapshot),0) +(SELECT OCTET_LENGTH(binding_snapshot)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(cwd),0)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(retained_digests),0)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(filesystem_receipt),0) FROM task_directory WHERE tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND task_id=t.id) +(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(request_snapshot)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(response_snapshot),0)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(directory_cwd),0)),0) FROM step WHERE tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND task_id=t.id) +(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(input_snapshot)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(output_snapshot),0)),0) FROM invocation WHERE tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND task_id=t.id) +(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(usage_snapshot),0)),0) FROM model_dispatch WHERE tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND task_id=t.id) +(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(base_cwd),0)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(target_cwd),0)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(canonical_paths_snapshot),0)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(directory_evidence_snapshot),0)),0) FROM invocation_path_binding WHERE tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND task_id=t.id) FROM task t WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{taskId}
